scores.reasons: Gap 5: no website, unclaimed profile, no address on Google. Pay 2: 6 reviews and a residential painting book, no commercial signals. Ease 4: claim plus a one-pager is a day's work. Evidence 3: Maps and Birdeye agree on identity, but licence status is only third-party data.

caveats: Ratings come from the Google Maps 'limited view' (no sign-in), which shows the star rating but suppresses the review count; counts are reported only where a directory aggregator (Birdeye, SnowLawn) published one.
Google Search itself returned the 'unusual traffic' CAPTCHA in the browser session, so Google snippets and knowledge panels could not be used; Google Maps was used instead.
Soriano P Landscaping's site sat behind a Cloudflare bot challenge for the whole session - website findings for that business are partly based on search-indexed copy and are unverified.
For no-website businesses, 'website_review' reflects the absence of a site (no layout, CTA, form or booking to test); the Google Business Profile was the only owned surface.
Licence and registration statuses cited (Soriano inactive, JM Painting expired) are third-party BuildZoom records, not verified against the NJ Division of Consumer Affairs.
'ability_to_pay' is a judgement from visible size signals only (reviews, years, service breadth, agency-built sites); no financial data was available for any business.

DL Landscaping's Google profile links to newbrunswickpavers.com (does not resolve) and shows a different phone than the site; it is not certain whether that profile belongs to the same operator - flagged rather than resolved.
data_gaps: Google review counts unavailable for Nieto, DL Landscaping, Felipe, Soriano, Daniel's, Erick Fence, Suburban Fence, D&R Painting and JM Painting (Maps limited view hides counts).
Soriano P Landscaping website could not be rendered - Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' page persisted after a 7s wait; no screenshot or form inspection possible.
Suburban Fence Co. could not be confirmed as a New Brunswick business: no Google listing in town, Birdeye record marked temporarily closed with 0 reviews.
No employee counts, revenue or years-in-business available for any business except self-reported claims (DL 12+, D&R 15).
DL Landscaping robots.txt returned an empty body, so crawl rules could not be read; Felipe's robots.txt returns 404.
No Google Search knowledge panels available (CAPTCHA block), so GBP claimed status was inferred from 'Claim this business' / 'Add missing information' prompts rather than an owner check.
